description: This file defines the 'Terms' ResultSet class within the Coocook schema, providing methods for ordering and filtering 'Terms' records based on date criteria.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::ResultSet::Terms
classes.description: A ResultSet class for handling 'Terms' records with methods for ordering and date-based filtering.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Returns a search result ordered by 'valid_from' date, either ascending or descending based on input parameter.

methods.name: valid_on_date_rs
methods.description: Returns a ResultSet of 'Terms' valid on a specific date, ordered by 'valid_from' descending.

methods.name: valid_on_date
methods.description: Retrieves a single 'Terms' record valid on a specific date.

methods.name: valid_today_rs
methods.description: Returns a ResultSet of 'Terms' valid today.

methods.name: valid_today
methods.description: Retrieves a single 'Terms' record valid today.
